summary: 25 Spaces has a licence number, a 4.9 Google rating and a modern layout. Repeated blocks and missing channels weaken a strong first impression, and Qatar buyers expect WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The first two Featured Listings are identical: the same Porto Arabia unit, price and specs. The Impact in Numbers block and the testimonials also appear two or more times.
findings.cost: A repeated listing in the first position wastes your best space and makes the site look careless to a buyer comparing agencies.
findings.fix: Unique featured listings and one clean version of each section.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp button or chat widget appears, even though WhatsApp is a main channel in Qatar. The enquiry form is the only way to ask.
findings.cost: A buyer who wants a quick answer on a listing messages another agency that offers WhatsApp.
findings.fix: A WhatsApp button on every listing with a pre-filled message.

findings.problem: The QAR 1,850,000 Viva East unit has no for sale label, so it can read as a rental. The form consent text is long and dense.
findings.cost: Unclear listings and heavy consent text cost enquiries from buyers who give up before sending.
findings.fix: Clear Buy or Rent labels on every card and a short, clear consent line.

findings.problem: Testimonials are attributed to first names or initials only, with no photos or dates, and the 17 + counter has a stray space. Social icons have no labels.
findings.cost: Unattributed proof is easy to doubt, and small errors weaken a licensed agency's image.
findings.fix: Named, dated reviews linked to your Google profile, and clean, labelled links.

redesign: A lead first homepage with unique featured listings, WhatsApp on every card and a short enquiry form.
Buy and Rent labels, and area pages written to rank for searches like apartments for sale The Pearl Doha.
Proof beside every enquiry button: licence number, named agents and dated reviews.
